name: 31_refraction_two_media_3d
energy_note: Staggered-field proxy; includes PML and is not an exact discrete invariant or calibrated joules.
detector_note: Mean sum of squared staggered electric components; not calibrated Poynting flux or antenna gain.
notes: 532 nm from thesis; 25 vacuum cells/wavelength. Finite phased beam replaces the under-resolved draft source. Angles are measured from +y; epsilon_r=n^2. Added z depth is 64 cells, dz=dx, with 12-cell z PML. The x-y geometry, grid spacing and time-step count are preserved. Gaussian beam in both transverse dimensions; x phase delay preserves the original incidence angle.
